# Year 10 Parents' Evening 2025-11-27

First online parents' evening, Year 10, Thursday 27 November 2025, 16:30 to 19:30. Video appointments booked through [[ledgerwise]], 5-minute slots, no in-person option.

## What Happened

- 162 of 209 families booked at least one appointment (78%), against 61% for Year 10 in person the year before.
- About nine appointments dropped mid-call; families were rung back by phone the following week. Two teachers' laptops needed a restart.
- Teachers finished on time. Several said 5 minutes was too short for a pupil with several concerns.
- I covered a slot for a colleague who was ill, which showed how hard it is to step in when you have not seen the books.

## Follow-up

Survey to families the next morning ([[parents-evening-survey-2025]]); findings in [[parents-evening-trial-findings]]. Second trial in hybrid format booked for [[year-10-parents-evening-2026-03-12|12 March]].
